sweep_definition: one heatbath sweep plus five overrelaxation sweeps

thermalization_and_blocking.method: per-chain MSER-5 with a 500-sweep minimum; Sokal-window tau_int; whole-history fused-replica error plateaus; separate complete within-chain blocks longer than 2 tau_int

blocking_error_plateau.method: whole post-cut histories; five-sweep elementary vectors; separate complete blocks per replica; replica-stratified delete-one-block jackknife; three-length error plateau

xi_exp_blocking_error_plateau.method: whole post-cut correlator histories; separate complete blocks per replica; fixed selected-fit covariance and range; replica-stratified delete-one-block refits
